question: For each year before 2000, find the driver who recorded the fastest lap time (in milliseconds) across all races in that year, and return their full name, nationality, and the name of the circuit where this fastest lap occurred.

prediction.sql:
WITH lap_ms AS (
  SELECT
    r."XCL_066" AS year,
    res."XCL_075" AS driver_id,
    r."XCL_068" AS circuit_id,
    (CAST(SUBSTR(res."XCL_088",1,INSTR(res."XCL_088",':')-1) AS INTEGER)*60000)
    + (CAST(SUBSTR(res."XCL_088",INSTR(res."XCL_088",':')+1,INSTR(res."XCL_088",".")-INSTR(res."XCL_088",':')-1) AS INTEGER)*1000)
    + CAST(SUBSTR(res."XCL_088",INSTR(res."XCL_088",".")+1) AS INTEGER) AS ms
  FROM races r
  INNER JOIN results res ON r."XCL_065" = res."XCL_074"
  WHERE r."XCL_066" < 2000 AND res."XCL_088" IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT year, driver_id, circuit_id, ms,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY ms ASC) AS rn
  FROM lap_ms
)
SELECT
  d."XCL_038" || ' ' || d."XCL_039" AS full_name,
  d."XCL_041" AS nationality,
  c."XCL_003" AS circuit_name
FROM ranked rk
INNER JOIN drivers d ON rk.driver_id = d."XCL_034"
INNER JOIN circuits c ON rk.circuit_id = c."XCL_001"
WHERE rk.rn = 1
ORDER BY rk.year
